confidence_notes: Full verbatim transcript of a 53:31 call, 355 turns, plus both a Quick notes and a Full notes section, so pricing, the budget constraint, the demo, the objections and the next steps are all directly evidenced. Account name is unambiguous: the title, the invitee cbowman@kempersports.com, and Christopher Bowman describing himself as the GM at the Berkeley course all agree. Rule 8 applies twice: The Divide Golf Club is the existing client course dialled during the demo, and Highland Creek is named only as a reference customer supplying the 97% and 50 to 55% figures - neither is the prospect. Judgement calls: (a) three objections, and the two budget-flavoured ones overlap - the timing objection is 'can I get it into the 2027 cycle at all', the approval_authority one is 'I have to build and defend the line inside a bucket I already own'; they are kept separate because the rep answered them differently, with a review-only agreement and a 2028 fallback for the first and an ROI calculator plus testimonials for the second. (b) The credit-card-on-file question is recorded as a prospect question and an unanswered question, not as an objection - Christopher raised it as a requirement check and voiced no doubt about the product. (c) Checkpoint order is not call order: pricing landed at about 00:16 and the budget constraint at about 00:20, both before the demo at 00:22, so at_pricing chronologically precedes post_demo. Trajectory is recorded as flat because the scores run 4 at the open, 3 at pricing, 4 after the demo and 3 at the close, and the budget constraint that holds the close down was already on the table at 00:13:50, before any of the product was shown.
